+from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy
+from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Numeric, DateTime, ForeignKey
+from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship
+from datetime import datetime
+
+db = SQLAlchemy()
+
+class Account(db.Model):
+    __tablename__ = 'banking_accounts'
+
+    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
+    user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('bb_users.id'), nullable=False)
+    currency = Column(String(3), nullable=False, default='USD')
+    balance = Column(Numeric(12, 4), nullable=False, default=0)
+    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
+
+    transactions = relationship('Transaction', backref='account', lazy=True)
+
+    def __init__(self, user_id, currency='USD', balance=0):
+        self.user_id = user_id
+        self.currency = currency
+        self.balance = balance
+
+    def __repr__(self):
+        return f'<Account {self.id} User{self.user_id} Balance:{self.balance} {self.currency}>'
+
+class Transaction(db.Model):
+    __tablename__ = 'banking_transactions'
+
+    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
+    account_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('banking_accounts.id'), nullable=False)
+    operation_type = Column(String(10), nullable=False) # 'deposit', 'credit', 'transfer'
+    amount = Column(Numeric(12, 4), nullable=False)
+    timestamp = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
+    reference_id = Column(Integer, nullable=True) # For transfers, stores recipient account ID
+
+    def __init__(self, account_id, operation_type, amount):
+        self.account_id = account_id
+        self.operation_type = operation_type
+        self.amount = amount
+
+    def __repr__(self):
+        return f'<Transaction {self.id} {self.operation_type} {self.amount}>'
